name: Purchasing agent
description: Answers for APQC process group 4.2, Procure materials and services: compares suppliers on record, drafts category plans and purchase orders, and tracks each supplier's performance. A person signs every contract and approves every order and spend.

onet.title: Purchasing Agents, Except Wholesale, Retail, and Farm Products
onet.basis: Process group 4.2 is sourcing governance, category plans, selecting suppliers and keeping contracts, ordering and managing suppliers, which is a purchasing agent's work; matched by the group's processes against the occupation title in O*NET 31.0.
